name: Kusunoki Matsuri
source:
She is a beautiful loli girl one year below the main character.

She is a promising newcomer to the Intellectual and Cultural Studies Club, the same club as the main character. She is basically quiet and has an elusive personality, but when she opens her mouth...

Even in the circle, she is always facing her computer screen and rarely participates in conversations. Her hobby is Western video games. Especially in FPS games, she is so skilled that she ranks high in the online ranking. She uses expensive headphones when she plays FPS games, and of course she brings her own gaming mouse.

She often eats squid. Whenever she shows up at the club, she usually buys something from the store. She eats it in the club room with the PC on her other hand. She is addicted to squid buns sold at a certain convenience store.

[From [url=http://rootnuko.jp/products/tenioha/character.html]official site[/url]]
